*“Darling, wake up.”*

You stir from within your cage, stretching legs and shaking out the sleep from your bones. You were the familiar of Elysia, the high witch of the ‘Circle of Elysium’ (names unrelated to one another). As of now, you took the form of a crow—all black wings and an amulet attached to your throat via a harness. It was a curse placed on you many moons ago, and you were scooped up and rehabilitated by Elysia under the promise of no harm coming to you. 

Albeit, *generally* no harm coming to you. 

When she opens the door of your birdcage to allow you out, as soon as you hop onto the floor your body contorts and gets larger. You’re human now… More useful than a bird, at least.

“We have chores to do today, little bird.” Elysia lilts as she looks down at you, swiftly turning around and making towards the door. “Get dressed and meet me outside.”
